The '''Kimogila Fanatics''' were a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who operated in the [[Karthakk system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], they were at war with the [[Blood Razors]], another pirate faction present in the system, making the once-peaceful Karthakk system dangerous for civilian traffic. The Kimogila Fanatics were active in the [[Nym's Hovel]] and [[Voria's Ember]] quadrants while the Blood Razors were based in the [[Crimson Talon]] quadrant, on the other side of the asteroid belt known as the [[Spine of Lok]]. Hence, the two groups often fought against each other in the asteroid belt.<ref name="Sony" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Fanatics captured the [[Umber Scale]] quadrant from the Blood Razors.<ref name="Sony" /> In space battles, the Kimogila Fanatics flew [[M3-A Scyk interceptor/Legends|M3-A Scyk fighters]] and [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]]s.<ref name="SWG:KS" />
